sentences: Two elements at vaddr + offset0·unit and vaddr + offset1·unit, unit = 8 bytes (×64 for st64); each element is two consecutive dwords, low first.
`read2_b64` fills v[d:d+3] after all four loads (a vdst overlapping vaddr is safe); `write2_b64` takes two VGPR pairs.
The b32 forms share the code with unit 4.

CPU-checked by `tests/semantic/test_lds_read2_write2_b64.py` (compute listings, LDS as a Workgroup variable); GPU-checked by `runtime/test/shaders/cs_lds_b64_cmpst.asm` (unit 8 and the 512-byte st64 forms, plus vdst/vaddr overlap, on an RTX 3070, driver 621.01, Windows 11).
